name: econ_5mt
source: racing_game-owned economy 5-speed manual transaxle, an invented design, NOT a specific gearbox [AS]. Long gearing for fuel economy: a tall fifth (0.70, an overdrive) and a first of 3.45, so the box is geared for low engine speed at motorway pace and gives up some acceleration; steps 1.77 / 1.52 / 1.38 / 1.33 stay under the 1.92 the car files' zero-throttle auto-shift points (up 2500 / down 1300 rpm) allow without shift hunting. Mesh efficiency 0.97-0.985 per gear (an economy box is built for low churning and friction loss, so slightly above the 0.96-0.98 of physics_sim's sedan_6mt) [AS]. Synchro capacities, shaft inertias and timings follow physics_sim's sedan_6mt scaled to a lighter 5-speed (input-shaft-referred cone synchros, reverse without a synchro) [AS]. Torque rating 320 N*m is kept in data/gearboxes/gearbox_catalog.json, not here (physics_sim's GearboxDesc has no rating yet).
